verdict.rationale: Ente documents end-to-end encrypted cloud backups and sync, says data is encrypted with a key derived from the user's password, and says Ente cannot recover the local-backup password, which implies the vendor does not hold the key. The pack contains no actual encryption design documentation (algorithms, key hierarchy, architecture whitepaper); only one-line marketing and help-page claims plus a note that the apps and server are open source. Missing for 10: published encryption design/architecture documentation, explicit statement that the cloud-backup key is never held by Ente, independent audit or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, backups are end-to-end encrypted with a key the vendor never holds, and the encryption design is documented
